en.bestFor: Lists of tips, tools, mistakes or reasons — "N things…" videos for Reels, Shorts, or carousels turned into video.
en.structure: Each clip runs 3–8 seconds. Items appear one by one, one item per clip. Only when the list is too long does a middle clip hold two or three items and reveal them one by one. The last clip always shows the full list.
en.hook: A clear frame. The spoken line is the largest text in the video, with a large count. No items, no checklist, and no extra props.
en.arc: Strong item first, weakest in the middle, best item last with the most vivid image. The clip after that shows the full list at rest.
en.narrator: An energetic, clear host talking to the viewer, with every item line in the same parallel shape (e.g. "Number one: …" or "Want X? Do Y.").
en.visual: Look and palette come from the chosen visual style. The hook's spoken line is the largest text, with a large count on an empty frame. Each item clip shows only that item, and each item uses a different camera angle and composition. The last clip is a clean full list of those short titles, evenly spaced, with no extra props.
en.audio: A driving beat that hits each time a number pops in and builds up on the final item.
en.rules: Items come only from your source — the list is never padded. Each item needs a concrete visual stand-in. An item clip's on-screen title is that item only; the full list is the last clip. Every clip also shows the spoken line as a subtitle.
